summary: Route standalone requirements to direct implementation; VDD create/repair requires explicit complete-directory request. Profiles: standard, resumable, self-hosted; choose least complex before model routing. Read three required references, repository authority, then knowledge and skill-input contracts. Lifecycle: draft>plan-ready>implementation-authorized>implementation-complete>acceptance-passed>archived; Bootstrap is optional and non-authorizing. Each slice declares behavior, failure selector/expected failure, acceptance, dependents, recovery; Quick Dev alone executes/owns RED. Terminal full validation is mandatory. Repairs stay in place under repair/round-n; historical artifacts immutable; default two semantic rounds, hard limit three with typed trigger, then manual_pause. Repair requires hash-bound lineage, changed-set manifests, callsite inventory, sibling disposition, controlled producer/consumer composition receipt, and complete review scope. Knowledge preflight and typed semantic-child skill-input gate must be ready before plan artifacts/plan-ready. Bind Git baseline plus frozen range or complete scoped dirty-worktree identity. Review is optional unless requested or protected-path rules require it; use minimal-complete-closure. Resumable/self-hosted require indexed append-only 95 report; standard usually omits it. Completion requires artifacts, observable acceptance paths, recorded negative/legacy path, stable targeted checks, and current terminal full validation.
